Arab League Rejects Hezbollah Military Actions in Lebanon

The Arab League has adopted a resolution that rejects the military activities of Hezbollah within Lebanon. The resolution specifically targets the Iran-backed movement's actions. This development comes amid ongoing concerns about Hezbollah's influence and operations in the region. The specific details of the resolution and its implications are being reported.
